tools.name: search_company
tools.description: Free ticker and company name lookup: find the ticker for a company name, or the company for a ticker. Data from SEC filings. Not investment advice.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Latest company financials from SEC filings for one ticker: revenue, net income, diluted EPS, operating income, total assets, cash, free cash flow and shares outstanding, for the latest fiscal year, latest quarter and trailing twelve months. Every number includes its period dates, the 10-K or 10-Q it

tools.name: get_fundamentals
tools.description: Latest company revenue, net income, EPS, operating income, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow or shares outstanding from SEC filings. Choose metrics and period (annual, quarterly or ttm). Latest values follow the fiscal year of each company, with the source

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Financial history of one metric from SEC filings, newest first: revenue history, net income history, EPS history, cash flow history and more, by year, quarter or trailing twelve months. Up to 200 periods, each with its 10-K or 10-Q, filing date and SEC link.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: SEC filing events across companies, newest first: 8-K items by plain name, Form 4 insider transactions and Schedule 13D and 13G stakes, each with its form, filing date, acceptance time, accession number, SEC link, CIK and ticker. Paid with x402 per call or with an API key.

tools.name: get_events_head
tools.description: Free: the newest cursor of the SEC events feed and, given a cursor, how many events are newer than it, so a poller pays only when there is something new. Data from SEC filings. Not investment advice.
